memorial.name: Alejandra
memorial.epitaph: Well. The wild. 20 days. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Vasyl
memorial.epitaph: I… don't think I'm coming back. The wild. 0 days… The journal — keep it. Please keep writing.

memorial.name: Petch
memorial.epitaph: I… don't think I'm coming back. The wild. 77 days… The journal — keep it. Please keep writing.

memorial.name: Catalina
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 0 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.

memorial.name: Kai
memorial.epitaph: Should this be my final entry: The wild. 1 day of stewardship. The record passes to my successor. Maintain it.

memorial.name: Ella
memorial.epitaph: Well. Starvation. 16 days. Statistically, someone had to go first. The journal's yours — try to die less dramatically than me.

memorial.name: Carlos
memorial.epitaph: The wild. 20d. Journal's yours now. The notes hold.

memorial.name: Luis
memorial.epitaph: If someone's reading this in my handwriting — I didn't make it back. The wild. 3 days I held it. The notes are good. Keep writing.
